headline: Mike Dimes Drops New Album with Maxo Kream: 'This Run He On Serious'
body: DJ Akademiks reports Mike Dimes has released a new album featuring visuals for his track with Maxo Kream. The post, published September 10, 2026, describes the project as 'this run he on serious'—a phrase suggesting intense creative momentum. The post garnered 538 likes and 161 comments on Instagram.
